name: Search a worldwide food and calculate its portion calories
description: Verifies the user can find a known food, choose a serving size and see its estimated calories.
expected: The portion calculator shows 260 kcal for 200 g of cooked white rice.

name: Log a food and view daily meal totals
description: Verifies adding a food updates the selected day's total and the meal log.
steps: Select a food and set its serving size
expected: The food appears under Lunch and the daily snapshot reflects its calculated calories.

name: Create a custom food with validation
description: Verifies custom food values can be entered and invalid portions are not accepted.
steps: Enter a food name and kcal per 100 g with a positive serving size
Save the custom food and inspect its portion calculator
expected: The custom food is added to the food list with its entered kcal-per-100-g value; invalid or empty values cannot be saved.

name: Remove a logged food and update totals
description: Verifies removing a logged entry updates both the log and the daily calorie summary.
setup: Add a food to the selected day's Lunch
expected: The food entry disappears and the daily total decreases by that entry's calories.
